Directions: Gently shake the container to loosen compressed powder. Add 1 level scoop (5 g) with 8 oz of Beachbody Performance Recover, water, or a high-carbohydrate beverage in accordance with recommended use below.
Standard use: 1 serving per day.
To  increase muscle creatine levels faster: 
Loading Phase: 4 servings per day (morning, midday, evening, and prior to sleep) for 5 days.
Maintenance Phase: 1 serving per day.
